summary: StealthGas Inc., a Marshall Islands-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed Form 6-K furnishing its 2026 proxy statement, proxy cards, and 2025 annual report ahead of its annual general meeting scheduled for October 9, 2026. The filing is a routine notice of meeting, covering director election and auditor ratification. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or management departure is present. This is a standard proxy circular for an annual meeting, so it does not constitute a special situation under the classification framework.
